sources.name: three.js
sources.note: As Kinetic ships it: the minified module with RoomEnvironment and RoundedBoxGeometry of its examples, for the 3D scenes (`../../components/scenes/three.mjs`). GLTFLoader and the BufferGeometryUtils it imports are the same release's examples (the loader's import of the utilities points at the file beside it), for the scene that draws a model from a file (`../../components/scenes/laptop3d.mjs`).
